# Project Learning Tree

> > Project Learning Tree (PLT) provides award-winning environmental and forestry education curriculum, outdoor learning activities, and professional development for PreK-12 educators.

PLT is a leader in environmental education, offering standards-aligned curriculum resources, outdoor teaching strategies, and recognition programs for outstanding educators. The program emphasizes hands-on learning experiences connecting students with nature, forests, and STEM concepts.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Education
- Outdoor Learning
- Forest Education
- STEM Education
- Professional Development
- Educator Resources
- Nature Education
- Outstanding Educators Program

## About PLT & Environmental Education

- [Why Environmental Education is Important](https://www.plt.org/about-us/why-environmental-education-is-important): Explains importance of environmental education for student achievement

## Curriculum Standards & Alignment

- [State Correlations](https://www.plt.org/alignment-to-standards/state): PLT curriculum alignment to state academic standards by US state

## Teaching Resources & Activities

- [Backyard Safari Activity Download](https://www.plt.org/backyard-safari-activity-download): Downloadable Backyard Safari K-8 outdoor nature exploration activity
- [Top Ten Tips for Teaching Outside - Elementary](https://www.plt.org/educator-tips/top-ten-tips-teaching-outside-elementary): Ten tips for elementary outdoor teaching and learning strategies
- [In Your Own Backyard](https://www.plt.org/activities-for-families/in-your-own-backyard): Outdoor family activities introducing children to nature and trees

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.plt.org/news): PLT news updates on environmental education and teacher resources
- [PLT's Newsletter - February 2026](https://www.plt.org/newsletter): Monthly PLT newsletter with environmental education tools and resources

## Educator Tips & Technology

- [Fun and Educational Science Apps for Elementary Students](https://www.plt.org/educator-tips/educational-science-apps-elementary-students): Science apps for elementary students covering climate, trees, conservation
